messages:
Liam: hey folks, new SRE here. trying to follow the onboarding checklist but hitting a 403 when the smoke job toggles a staging feature flag. do new hires get console admin or is there a different flow?

Noor: welcome! we avoid giving personal admin. usual flow: request a short-lived service account scoped to the staging project with the ff-operator role.

Liam: i requested via access portal but not sure what justification to paste. any tips?

Noor: keep it brief: 'onboarding smoke tests require programmatic flag toggles, 4h ttl'. add the repo link and CI job name. infra will create the SA after approval.

infra-bot: Reminder: creating service accounts will generate an audit ticket. See https://go/redwood-infra/sa-policy.

Liam: thanks. can someone expedite? my onboarding task is blocked.

Zoe: i can create a 4h SA now. name preference?

Liam: liam-onboard-1829998888 works. thanks Zoe.

Zoe: done. token uploaded to secrets path projects/redwood-secrets/staging/liam-onboard. added ff-operator role. fetch example: `gcloud secrets versions access latest --secret=liam-onboard --project=redwood-internal`

Liam: fetched token and reran the job, toggles worked and the smoke tests passed. closing out, appreciate the quick help :rocket:
